metadata.name: Glacier Line
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A battle across a snowfield in a blizzard. The Defenders hold an ice base cut into a glacier: a hangar with two skyfighters and a transport, ice corridors, a command centre with red alert lights, a medical bay and the power generator, behind a trench line of mounted guns and a giant dish. The Attackers push up from a staging camp behind three giant four-legged walkers that lurch up the field and back: shelter under one, but keep clear of its feet. Snow sleds, a tank and a gunship for the push. Bomb: blow the generator (A) or the hangar fuel store (B).
